scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "BARCODE_POS_DB=$INIT_CWD/data/pos.sqlite npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w client && npm run build -w server
scripts.start: npm run build -w server && BARCODE_POS_DB=$INIT_CWD/data/pos.sqlite npm run start -w server
scripts.desktop:dev: npm run build && npm run build:main -w barcode-pos-desktop && npm run dev -w barcode-pos-desktop
scripts.desktop:pack:mac: npm run build && npm run desktop:prepare && npm run pack:mac -w barcode-pos-desktop
scripts.desktop:pack:win: npm run build && DESKTOP_PACK_PLATFORM=win32 DESKTOP_PACK_ARCH=x64 npm run desktop:prepare && npm run pack:win -w barcode-pos-desktop
